title.zh: 卷五十三 列傳第二十三 愍懷太子
title.en: Volume 53 Biographies 23: Crown Prince Minhuai
title.raw: 卷五十三 列傳第二十三 愍懷太子 Volume 53 Biographies 23: Crown Prince Minhuai

units.zh: 愍懷太子
units.literal: Crown Prince Minhuai
units.idiomatic: Crown Prince Minhuai

units.zh: 湣懷太子遹，字熙祖，惠帝長子，母曰謝才人。
units.literal: Crown Prince Minhuai, Yu, courtesy name Xizu, was Emperor Hui's eldest son; his mother was Talented Lady Xie.
units.idiomatic: Crown Prince Minhuai, Yu, courtesy name Xizu, was Emperor Hui's eldest son; his mother was Talented Lady Xie.

units.zh: 幼而聰慧，武帝愛之，恆在左右。
units.literal: From childhood he was clever and bright; Emperor Wu loved him and kept him always at his side.
units.idiomatic: From childhood he was clever and bright; Emperor Wu loved him and kept him always at his side.

units.zh: 初，賈后母郭槐欲以韓壽女為太子妃，太子亦欲婚韓氏以自固。
units.literal: Earlier Empress Jia's mother Guo Huai had wished to take Han Shou's daughter as crown princess; the crown prince also wished to marry the Hans to strengthen himself.
units.idiomatic: Earlier, Empress Jia's mother, Guo Huai, had wanted Han Shou's daughter to become crown princess. The crown prince also hoped that marrying into the Han family would strengthen his position.

units.zh: 而壽妻賈午及後皆不聽，而為太子聘王衍小女惠風。
units.literal: But Han Shou's wife Jia Wu and the empress both refused and instead betrothed the crown prince to Wang Yan's younger daughter Huifeng.
units.idiomatic: But Han Shou's wife Jia Wu and the empress both refused, and instead betrothed the crown prince to Wang Yan's younger daughter Huifeng.

units.zh: 太子聞衍長女美，而賈后為謐聘之，心不能平，頗以為言。
units.literal: The crown prince heard Wang's elder daughter was beautiful while the empress betrothed her to Jia Mi; his heart could not rest easy and he spoke of it often.
units.idiomatic: The crown prince heard Wang's elder daughter was beautiful while the empress betrothed her to Jia Mi; his heart could not rest easy and he spoke of it often.

units.zh: 謐嘗與太子圍棋，爭道，成都王穎見而訶謐，謐意愈不平，因此譖太子于後曰：「太子廣買田業，多畜私財以結小人者，為賈氏故也。
units.literal: Once Mi played go with the crown prince and they quarreled over the move; Ying, Prince of Chengdu, saw and rebuked Mi; Mi grew more resentful and therefore slandered the crown prince to the empress: 'The crown prince buys fields wholesale, hoards private wealth, and courts petty men—all because of the Jia clan.
units.idiomatic: Once while playing go with the crown prince Mi quarreled over a move; Ying, Prince of Chengdu, saw and rebuked Mi; Mi grew more resentful and slandered the crown prince to the empress: "The crown prince buys fields wholesale, hoards private wealth, and courts petty men—all because of the Jia clan.

units.zh: 沙門，太子小字也。
units.literal: 'Shamen' was the crown prince's childhood byname.
units.idiomatic: 'Shamen' was the crown prince's childhood byname.

units.zh: 初，太子之廢也，妃父王衍表請離婚。
units.literal: When the crown prince was first deposed, his father-in-law Wang Yan memorialized requesting divorce.
units.idiomatic: When the crown prince was first deposed, his father-in-law Wang Yan memorialized requesting divorce.

units.zh: 太子至許，遺妃書曰：「鄙雖頑愚，心念為善，欲盡忠孝之節，無有惡逆之心。
units.literal: After the crown prince reached Xu he sent his consort a letter: 'Though I am coarse and foolish at heart I wished to do good and fulfill loyalty and filial piety—I harbored no rebellious evil.
units.idiomatic: After reaching Xu he sent his consort a letter: "Though I am coarse and foolish, at heart I wished to do good and fulfill loyalty and filial piety—I harbored no rebellious evil.

title.en: Volume 269 Biographies 28: Tao Gu, Hu Meng, Wang Zhe, Wang You, Yang Zhaojian, Yu Chongliang, Zhang Dan, Gao Xi
title.raw: 卷二百六十九 列傳第二十八 陶穀 扈蒙 王著 王祐 楊昭儉 魚崇諒 張澹 高錫 Volume 269 Biographies 28: Tao Gu, Hu Meng, Wang Zhe, Wang You, Yang Zhaojian, Yu Chongliang, Zhang Dan, Gao Xi

units.zh: 陶穀，字秀實，邠州新平人。
units.literal: Tao Gu, courtesy name Xiushi, was a native of Xinping in Bin Prefecture.
units.idiomatic: Tao Gu, styled Xiushi, came from Xinping in Bin Prefecture.

units.zh: 本姓唐，避晉祖諱改焉。
units.literal: His original surname was Tang; he changed it to avoid the taboo name of the Jin founding emperor.
units.idiomatic: The family had originally borne the surname Tang but changed it to evade the imperial taboo of the Jin founder.

units.zh: 歷北齊、隋、唐為名族。
units.literal: Through Northern Qi, Sui, and Tang they were a distinguished clan.
units.idiomatic: For generations under the Northern Qi, Sui, and Tang they had ranked among the great families.

units.zh: 漢乾祐中，舉進士。
units.literal: In Han's Qianyou era he was recommended for the jinshi examination.
units.idiomatic: During the Qianyou era of Later Han he sat for the jinshi examination.

units.zh: 王晏鎮徐州，辟掌書記；
units.literal: When Wang Yan commanded Xuzhou he recruited him as chief secretary;
units.idiomatic: When Wang Yan governed Xuzhou he recruited Xi as his chief secretary;

units.zh: 留守西洛，又辟河南府推官。
units.literal: when stationed at Western Luoyang he again recruited him as investigating officer of Henan Prefecture.
units.idiomatic: and when Wang held the western capital he also appointed Xi investigating officer of Henan Prefecture.

units.zh: 坐按獄失實奪官，遷置涇州，會赦得歸。
units.literal: He was stripped of office for investigating a case that did not accord with facts, was transferred and assigned to Jing Prefecture, and upon a general amnesty was allowed to return.
units.idiomatic: He lost his post when a criminal case he handled proved unfounded; after being reassigned to Jing Prefecture he was able to return home when an amnesty was proclaimed.

title.zh: 卷三十二 本紀第三十二 高宗九
title.en: Volume 32 Annals 32: Gaozong 9
title.raw: 卷三十二 本紀第三十二 高宗九 Volume 32 Annals 32: Gaozong 9

units.zh: 三十一年春正月甲戌朔，以日食，不受朝。
units.literal: Thirty-first year, spring, first month, day jiaxu new moon: because of a solar eclipse, court audience was not held.
units.idiomatic: Year 31, spring, jiaxu new moon: Gaozong canceled audience for the eclipse.

units.zh: 丁丑，雷。
units.literal: Day dingchou: thunder.
units.idiomatic: On dingchou, thunder rolled.

units.zh: 丁亥，免湖州增丁所輸絹。
units.literal: Day dinghai: the silk paid by Huzhou for added registered households was remitted.
units.idiomatic: On dinghai, Huzhou was freed from added-household silk levies.

units.zh: 乙未，行新造會子於淮、浙、湖北、京西諸州。
units.literal: Day yiwei: newly minted exchange notes were put into circulation in the Huai, Zhe, Hubei, and Jingxi prefectures.
units.idiomatic: On yiwei, new exchange notes circulated in the Huai, Zhe, Hubei, and Jingxi.

units.zh: 是月，金主亮徙都汴京，命其臣劉萼由唐、鄧瞰荊、襄，張中彥、王彥章據秦、鳳、窺巴、蜀，蘇保衡、完顏鄭家奴由海道趨兩浙。
units.literal: That month, the Jin ruler Hailing moved the capital to Bianjing; he ordered his minister Liu E from Tang and Deng to overlook Jing and Xiang; Zhang Zhongyan and Wang Yanchang to hold Qin and Feng and spy on Ba and Shu; Su Baoheng and Wanyan Zhengjianu by sea toward the two Zhes.
units.idiomatic: That month Hailing moved to Bianjing; Liu E threatened Jing and Xiang from Tang and Deng; Zhang Zhongyan and Wang Yanchang menaced Ba and Shu from Qin and Feng; Su Baoheng and Wanyan Zhengjianu sailed toward Zhe.

units.zh: 八月辛丑朔，忠義人魏勝復海州，李寶承制以勝知州事。
units.literal: Eighth month, day xinchou new moon: loyalist Wei Sheng recovered Haizhou; Li Bao, by provisional order, made Sheng prefect.
units.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinchou new moon: Wei Sheng retook Haizhou; Li Bao made him prefect.

units.zh: 丙辰，金主亮入廬州，王權自昭關遁，金人追至尉子橋，破敵軍統制姚興戰死，權退保和州。
units.literal: Day bingchen: the Jin ruler Hailing entered Luzhou; Wang Quan fled from Zhaoguan; the Jin pursued to Weizi Bridge; Break-the-Enemy controller Yao Xing died fighting; Quan fell back to defend Hezhou.
units.idiomatic: On bingchen, Hailing entered Luzhou; Wang Quan fled Zhaoguan; at Weizi Bridge Yao Xing fell; Quan held Hezhou.

units.zh: 金州都統制王彥遣統制任天錫出洵陽，復豐陽縣。
units.literal: Jinzhou overall commander Wang Yan sent controller Ren Tiansi out of Xunyang and recovered Fengyang county.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan's Ren Tiansi left Xunyang and retook Fengyang.

units.zh: 丁巳，帝聞王權敗，召楊存中同宰執議於內殿，陳康伯贊帝定議親征。
units.literal: Day dingsi: the Emperor, hearing Wang Quan was defeated, summoned Yang Cunzhong with the chief ministers to discuss in the inner hall; Chen Kangbo praised the Emperor for fixing on campaigning in person.
units.idiomatic: On dingsi, hearing of Wang Quan's defeat, Gaozong called Yang Cunzhong and the councilors within; Chen Kangbo praised his resolve to take the field.

units.zh: 金主亮焚其舟而去。
units.literal: The Jin ruler Hailing burned his boats and left.
units.idiomatic: Hailing burned his boats and withdrew.

units.zh: 戊寅，王彥遣將楊堅復欒川縣。
units.literal: Day wuyin: Wang Yan sent General Yang Jian to recover Luanchuan county.
units.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wang Yan's Yang Jian retook Luanchuan.

units.zh: 己卯，以湯思退為行宮留守。
units.literal: Day jimao: Tang Situi was made mobile-court resident.
units.idiomatic: On jimao, Tang Situi was made mobile-court resident.

units.zh: 復犯襄陽，統制官李勝等拒卻之，復通化軍。
units.literal: They again attacked Xiangyang; controller Li Sheng and others repelled them and restored Tonghua army.
units.idiomatic: They struck Xiangyang again; controller Li Sheng and others drove them off and restored Tonghua army.

units.zh: 王彥遣將楊堅、黨清至西京長水縣及金人戰，敗之。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent generals Yang Jian and Dang Qing to Changshui county west of the Western Capital and fought the Jin, defeating them.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent Yang Jian and Dang Qing to Changshui west of the Western Capital, fought the Jin, and won.

units.zh: 庚寅，復長水縣。
units.literal: Day gengyin: Changshui county was restored.
units.idiomatic: On gengyin, Changshui county was restored.

units.zh: 十二月己亥朔，趙撙夜襲蔡州，復入其城。
units.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai new moon: Zhao Zong by night raided Cai prefecture and re-entered its walls.
units.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jihai new moon: Zhao Zong night-raided Cai prefecture and re-entered the city.

units.zh: 王彥遣兵復福昌縣。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent troops to recover Fuchang county.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent troops to retake Fuchang county.

units.zh: 庚子，楊存中及虞允文渡江至瓜州察金兵。
units.literal: Day gengzi: Yang Cunzhong and Yu Yunwen crossed the river to Guazhou to inspect Jin troops.
units.idiomatic: On gengzi, Yang Cunzhong and Yu Yunwen crossed to Guazhou to scout the Jin.

units.zh: 金統軍劉萼聞茨湖敗，亦退師。
units.literal: Jin overall commander Liu E, hearing of the defeat at Cihu, also withdrew his army.
units.idiomatic: Jin commander Liu E, hearing of Cihu's defeat, also withdrew.

units.zh: 王彥遣將閻玘復澠池縣。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent general Yan Qi to recover Mianchi county.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent Yan Qi to retake Mianchi county.

units.zh: 壬寅，天有白氣。
units.literal: Day renyin: white vapor appeared in the sky.
units.idiomatic: On renyin, white vapor appeared in the sky.

units.zh: 戊午，復引兵來攻，撙又敗之，金兵遁去。
units.literal: Day wuwu: they came again; Zong again defeated them and the Jin fled.
units.idiomatic: On wuwu, they returned; Zong defeated them again and the Jin fled.

units.zh: 王彥遣將馬貴斷河中南橋，金兵來攻，貴戰敗之。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent general Ma Gui to cut the south bridge on the Yellow River; the Jin came to attack and Gui defeated them.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent Ma Gui to cut the Yellow River's south bridge; the Jin attacked and Gui defeated them.

units.zh: 壬戌，詔軍士戰死者祿其家一年，傷重而死于營者半之。
units.literal: Day renxu: an edict granted one year's salary to families of soldiers killed in battle; half for those who died in camp of severe wounds.
units.idiomatic: On renxu, families of soldiers killed in battle received one year's salary; half for those who died in camp of severe wounds.

units.zh: 姚仲遣副將趙銓攻下鎮戎軍，金同知渭州秦弼及其子嵩來歸。
units.literal: Yao Zhong sent deputy Zhao Quan to take Zhenrong army; Jin acting Wei prefecture commissioner Qin Bi and his son Song came over.
units.idiomatic: Yao Zhong's deputy Zhao Quan took Zhenrong army; Jin acting Wei commissioner Qin Bi and his son Song defected.

units.zh: 王彥遣兵救陝州，遇金人於虢州東，敗之，金兵引去。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent troops to relieve Shan prefecture, met the Jin east of Guo prefecture, defeated them, and the Jin withdrew.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent relief to Shan, met the Jin east of Guo, defeated them, and the Jin withdrew.

units.zh: 丁卯，吳珙遣將復永安軍、永寧、福昌、長水三縣。
units.literal: Day dingmao: Wu Gong sent generals to recover Yong'an army and the three counties Yongning, Fuchang, and Changshui.
units.idiomatic: On dingmao, Wu Gong's generals retook Yong'an army and Yongning, Fuchang, and Changshui counties.

units.zh: 甲辰，罷扈從官吏賞典。
units.literal: Day jiachen: reward grants to officials of the imperial retinue were abolished.
units.idiomatic: On jiachen, reward grants to retinue officials were abolished.

units.zh: 乙巳，錄商、虢之功，加吳璘少傅、王彥為保平軍節度使。
units.literal: Day yisi: the merits at Shang and Guo were recorded; Wu Lin was advanced to junior mentor and Wang Yan was made Baoping military commissioner.
units.idiomatic: On yisi, merits at Shang and Guo were recorded; Wu Lin was made junior mentor and Wang Yan Baoping military commissioner.

units.zh: 戊申，吳璘復德順軍，又遣將嚴忠取環州。
units.literal: Day wushen: Wu Lin recovered Deshun army and also sent general Yan Zhong to take Huanzhou.
units.idiomatic: On wushen, Wu Lin recovered Deshun and sent Yan Zhong to take Huanzhou.

title.zh: 卷二百五十二 列傳第十一 王景 王晏 郭從義 李洪信 武行德 楊承信 侯章
title.en: Volume 252 Biographies 11: Wang Jing, Wang Yan, Guo Congyi, Li Hongxin, Wu Xingde, Yang Chengxin, Hou Zhang
title.raw: 卷二百五十二 列傳第十一 王景 王晏 郭從義 李洪信 武行德 楊承信 侯章 Volume 252 Biographies 11: Wang Jing, Wang Yan, Guo Congyi, Li Hongxin, Wu Xingde, Yang Chengxin, Hou Zhang

units.zh: 王景，萊州掖人，家世力田。
units.literal: Wang Jing was a native of Ye in Laizhou; his family for generations tilled the fields.
units.idiomatic: Wang Jing came from Ye in Laizhou. His family had farmed the land for generations.

units.zh: 景少倜儻，善騎射，不事生業，結里中惡少為群盜。
units.literal: When young, Jing was bold and unconventional, skilled at mounted archery, did not pursue a livelihood, and joined local ruffians as a band of robbers.
units.idiomatic: In youth he was daring and free-spirited, an excellent horseman and archer who shunned honest work and banded with neighborhood troublemakers as outlaws.

units.zh: 梁大將王檀鎮滑臺，以景隸麾下，與後唐莊宗戰河上，檀有功，景嘗左右之。
units.literal: The Liang general Wang Tan garrisoned Huatai and placed Jing under his command; when fighting Later Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong on the Yellow River, Tan won merit and Jing often assisted at his side.
units.idiomatic: Liang general Wang Tan held Huatai and took Jing into his service. In the river battles against Later Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong, Tan earned distinction, and Jing was often at his side.

units.zh: 聞者咸笑之，因目為『王當代』。
units.literal: Hearers all laughed at this, and so he was nicknamed "Wang the Successor."
units.idiomatic: Everyone who heard it laughed, and people nicknamed him "Wang the Successor."

units.zh: 王晏，徐州滕人，家世力田。
units.literal: Wang Yan was a native of Teng in Xuzhou; his family for generations tilled the fields.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan came from Teng in Xuzhou. His family had farmed for generations.

units.zh: 晏少壯勇無賴，嘗率群寇行攻劫。
units.literal: When young Yan was bold, fierce, and unruly; he once led a band of robbers in raids and plunder.
units.idiomatic: In youth Yan was fierce and lawless and led gangs in robbery and pillage.

units.zh: 梁末，徐方大亂，屬邑皆為他盜所剽，惟晏鄉里恃晏獲全。
units.literal: At the end of Liang, the Xu region was greatly disturbed; subordinate districts were all plundered by other bandits, but only Yan's home village, relying on Yan, was kept intact.
units.idiomatic: Late in the Liang, chaos engulfed Xu. Neighboring districts were looted by other bandits, but Yan's home village alone was spared because of him.

units.zh: 後唐同光中，應募隸禁軍，累遷奉國小校。
units.literal: In the Later Tang Tongguang era he answered the levy and joined the palace army, rising through posts to junior officer of the Fengguo Guard.
units.idiomatic: Under Later Tang in the Tongguang era he enlisted in the palace army and rose to junior officer of the Fengguo Guard.

units.zh: 晉開運末，與本軍都校趙暉、忠衛都校侯章等戍陜州。
units.literal: At the end of Jin Kaiyun, together with his army's colonel Zhao Hui, the Zhongwei Guard's colonel Hou Zhang, and others, he garrisoned Shaanzhou.
units.idiomatic: Late in the Jin Kaiyun reign he garrisoned Shaanzhou with his colonel Zhao Hui, Zhongwei colonel Hou Zhang, and others.

units.zh: 行德率部民萬餘完其城，封邢國公。
units.literal: Xingde led more than ten thousand local people to complete the city and was enfeoffed as Duke of Xing.
units.idiomatic: Xingde led more than ten thousand local people to complete the walls and was enfeoffed as Duke of Xing.

units.zh: 是秋，代王晏為武寧軍節度，與晏兩換其任。
units.literal: That autumn he replaced Wang Yan as military governor of the Wuning army, the two exchanging their posts.
units.idiomatic: That autumn he and Wang Yan exchanged posts, Xingde taking the Wuning governorship.

units.zh: 先是，唐末楊氏據淮甸，自甬橋東南決汴，匯為汙澤。
units.literal: Earlier, late in Tang the Yang clan held the Huai region; from Yongqiao southeast they breached the Bian River, which pooled into a foul marsh.
units.idiomatic: Earlier, late in Tang the Yang clan held the Huai region. Southeast of Yongqiao they breached the Bian River, turning it into a foul marsh.

units.zh: 晉開運末，為忠衛指揮使，屯兵陜州，為內外馬步軍都指揮使兼三城巡檢使。
units.literal: At the end of Jin Kaiyun he was commander of the Loyal Guard, garrisoned troops at Shaanzhou, and served as overall commander of the inner and outer horse and foot armies, concurrently patrol commissioner of the three cities.
units.idiomatic: Late in the Jin Kaiyun reign he commanded the Loyal Guard at Shaanzhou and served as overall commander of the inner and outer armies and patrol commissioner of the three cities.

units.zh: 會契丹入中原，與趙暉、王晏謀斬契丹將劉愿，送款於漢祖。
units.literal: When the Khitan entered the central plains, together with Zhao Hui and Wang Yan he plotted to behead the Khitan general Liu Yuan and sent allegiance to the Han founding emperor.
units.idiomatic: When the Khitan overran the central plains, he joined Zhao Hui and Wang Yan in killing the Khitan general Liu Yuan and submitting to the Han emperor.

units.zh: 漢祖入汴，擢為鎮國軍節度。
units.literal: When the Han founding emperor entered Bian, Zhang was promoted to military governor of Zhenguo.
units.idiomatic: When the Han emperor entered Bian, Zhang was made military governor of Zhenguo.

units.zh: 景趨利改圖，乃至滅族。
units.literal: Jing, pursuing profit, changed his course, even to the extermination of his clan.
units.idiomatic: Yet Jing, chasing profit, changed course—and brought his clan to ruin.

units.zh: 王晏、郭從義遷怒肆忿，誣人以死。
units.literal: Wang Yan and Guo Congyi shifted anger and vented wrath, framing men to death.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan and Guo Congyi vented their rage on others and framed innocent men to death.

units.zh: 侯章在藩邸有剝下之名，李洪義狃於肺腑之戚，而無外凜之志，咎孰甚焉！
units.literal: Hou Zhang had a reputation at his regional command for stripping subordinates; Li Hongyi was accustomed to kinship of flesh and blood yet lacked outward awe-inspiring resolve—whose fault was the greater!
units.idiomatic: Hou Zhang was known for exploiting his subjects. Li Hongyi rested on family ties and lacked the outward sternness a commander needs—who was more to blame?

units.zh: 高帝十九男：昭皇后生武帝、豫章文獻王嶷；
units.literal: Emperor Gao had nineteen sons: Empress Zhao bore Emperor Wu and Prince Wenxian of Yuzhang Ni;
units.idiomatic: Emperor Gao had nineteen sons: Empress Zhao bore Emperor Wu and Prince Wenxian of Yuzhang, Ni;

units.zh: 謝貴嬪生臨川獻王映、長沙威王晃；
units.literal: Noble Consort Xie bore Prince Xian of Linchuan Ying and Prince Wei of Changsha Huang;
units.idiomatic: Noble Consort Xie bore Prince Xian of Linchuan, Ying, and Prince Wei of Changsha, Huang;

units.zh: 羅太妃生武陵昭王曄；
units.literal: Consort Dowager Luo bore Prince Zhao of Wuling Ye;
units.idiomatic: Consort Dowager Luo bore Prince Zhao of Wuling, Ye;

units.zh: 鉉年稍長。
units.literal: Xuan grew somewhat older.
units.idiomatic: Xuan grew somewhat older.

units.zh: 四年，誅王晏，以謀立鉉為名，免鉉官，以王還第，禁不得與外人交通。
units.literal: In year four Wang Yan was executed; on the charge of plotting to enthrone Xuan, Xuan was stripped of office, sent back to his mansion as a prince, and forbidden to have contact with outsiders.
units.idiomatic: In year four Wang Yan was executed; on the charge of plotting to enthrone Xuan, Xuan was stripped of office, sent back to his mansion, and forbidden contact with outsiders.

units.zh: 永泰元年，上疾暴甚，遂害鉉，時年十九。
units.literal: In the first year of Yongtai the emperor's illness suddenly worsened; he then killed Xuan, who was then nineteen.
units.idiomatic: In Yongtai year one the emperor's illness suddenly worsened; he then killed Xuan, who was nineteen.

units.zh: 天福四年春正月癸卯，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。
units.literal: In the fourth year of Tianfu, on the guimao day of the first month in spring, the Emperor took his seat in the Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; the guard of honor followed the prescribed form.
units.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the first day of the first month of spring in the fourth year of Tianfu, the emperor took the throne in the Chongyuan Hall to receive the New Year court congratulations, with the guard of honor arrayed according to custom.

units.zh: 丙午，召太子太師致仕範延光宴於便殿。
units.literal: On the bingwu day, he summoned Fan Yanguang, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent who had retired from office, and gave him a banquet in the informal hall.
units.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the emperor summoned Fan Yanguang, the retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, to a banquet in the informal hall.

units.zh: 以延光歸命之後，慮懷疑懼，故休假之內，錫以款密。
units.literal: Because after Yanguang had submitted, he was anxious with suspicion and fear, therefore during his leave of absence the Emperor bestowed intimate attentions upon him.
units.idiomatic: After Fan Yanguang had surrendered, he was troubled by suspicion and fear; during his leave of absence the emperor therefore treated him with warm and confidential kindness.

units.zh: 御史中丞薛融改尚書左丞；
units.literal: Xue Rong, Vice Censor-in-Chief, was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs;
units.idiomatic: Xue Rong was transferred to left vice director of the Department of State Affairs;

units.zh: 尚書右丞王延改吏部侍郎；
units.literal: Wang Yan, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel;
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan was transferred to vice minister of personnel;

units.zh: 尚書左丞崔棁改太常卿。
units.literal: Cui Zhuo, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was transferred to Chief Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
units.idiomatic: and Cui Zhuo was transferred to chief minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

units.literal: Book of Southern Qi, Volume 3, Annals 3
units.idiomatic: Book of Southern Qi, Volume 3, Annals 3

units.zh: 世祖武皇帝諱賾，字宣遠，太祖長子也。
units.literal: Emperor Wu, canonically titled Grand Successor, taboo name Ze, style Xuanyuan, was the Grand Progenitor's eldest son.
units.idiomatic: Emperor Wu, whose temple name was Shizu, bore the taboo name Ze and the style Xuanyuan; he was the Grand Progenitor's eldest son.

units.zh: 小諱龍兒。
units.literal: His childhood taboo was Long'er.
units.idiomatic: In childhood he was called Long'er.

units.zh: 奉聖之爵，以時紹繼。」
units.literal: The fief of Fengsheng is to be continued in its season."
units.idiomatic: Let the Fengsheng marquisate pass in due time."

units.zh: 壬寅，以丹陽尹王晏爲江州刺史。
units.literal: On day renyin, Palace Attendant Wang Yan was made Inspector of Jiangzhou.
units.idiomatic: Day renyin: Wang Yan, intendant of Danyang, was made inspector of Jiangzhou.

units.zh: 癸卯，以巴陵王子倫爲豫州刺史。
units.literal: On day guimao, Prince of Baling Xiao Zilun was made Inspector of Yuzhou.
units.idiomatic: Day guimao: Xiao Zilun, prince of Baling, took Yu.

units.zh: 內外衆事，無大小悉與鸞參懷，共下意。
units.literal: inside and outside, matters great and small—all consult with Luan and share your intent.
units.idiomatic: within and without, great affairs and small—take counsel with Luan and speak with one mind.

units.zh: 尚書中是職務根本，悉委王晏、徐孝嗣。
units.literal: Within the Masters of Writing lies the root of office—entrust it wholly to Wang Yan and Xu Xiaosi.
units.idiomatic: The Masters of Writing are the root of government—leave them to Wang Yan and Xu Xiaosi.

units.zh: 軍旅捍邊之略，委王敬則、陳顯達、王廣之、王玄邈、沈文季、張瑰、薛淵等。
units.literal: The strategy of armies defending the border—entrust it to Wang Jingze, Chen Xianda, Wang Guangzhi, Wang Xuanmiao, Shen Wenji, Zhang Gui, Xue Yuan, and the rest.
units.idiomatic: Border defense goes to Wang Jingze, Chen Xianda, Wang Guangzhi, Wang Xuanmiao, Shen Wenji, Zhang Gui, Xue Yuan, and the rest.

title.en: Volume 44 Biographies 25: Xu Xiaosi, Shen Wenji

units.literal: Book of Southern Qi, Volume 44, Biographies 25
units.idiomatic: Book of Southern Qi, Volume 44, Biographies 25

units.zh: 徐孝嗣 沈文季
units.literal: Xu Xiaosi, Shen Wenji
units.idiomatic: Xu Xiaosi and Shen Wenji

units.zh: 徐孝嗣字始昌，東海郯人也。
units.literal: Xu Xiaosi, courtesy name Shichang, was a man of Tan in Donghai.
units.idiomatic: Xu Xiaosi, whose courtesy name was Shichang, came from Tan in Donghai Commandery.

units.zh: 給班劔二十人，加兵百人。
units.literal: He was given twenty ceremonial guards and one hundred added troops.
units.idiomatic: He was given twenty ceremonial guards and one hundred added troops.

units.zh: 舊拜三公乃臨軒，至是帝特詔與陳顯達、王晏竝臨軒拜授。
units.literal: Formerly only when invested as one of the Three Excellencies did one approach the imperial steps; on this occasion the emperor specially ordered that he, Chen Xianda, and Wang Yan together receive investiture before the imperial steps.
units.idiomatic: Formerly investiture as one of the Three Excellencies alone warranted approaching the imperial steps; on this occasion the emperor specially ordered that he, Chen Xianda, and Wang Yan together receive investiture before the imperial steps.

units.zh: 北虜動，詔孝嗣假節頓新亭。
units.literal: When the northern barbarians stirred, an edict appointed Xiaosi with provisional credentials to hold Xinting.
units.idiomatic: When the northern enemy stirred, an edict appointed Xiaosi with provisional credentials to hold Xinting.

units.zh: 時王晏爲令，民情物望，不及孝嗣也。
units.literal: At that time Wang Yan was chief minister; in popular esteem he did not match Xiaosi.
units.idiomatic: At that time Wang Yan was chief minister, yet in popular esteem he did not match Xiaosi.

units.zh: 晏誅，轉尚書令，領本州中正，餘悉如故。
units.literal: When Yan was executed, Xiaosi was transferred to Director of the Secretariat, heading the nativist zhongzheng of his home province, all else unchanged.
units.idiomatic: When Yan was executed, Xiaosi was transferred to Director of the Secretariat and retained his post as nativist zhongzheng for his home province; all other appointments remained unchanged.

units.zh: 明帝卽位，加領太子詹事，增邑五百戶。
units.literal: When Emperor Ming took the throne Wenji was additionally made concurrent Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent with five hundred added households.
units.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming took the throne, Wenji was additionally appointed concurrent Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent, with five hundred added households in his fief.

units.zh: 尚書令王晏嘗戲文季爲吳興僕射。
units.literal: Director of the Secretariat Wang Yan once teased Wenji as the Wuxing Vice Director.
units.idiomatic: Director of the Secretariat Wang Yan once teased Wenji as the "Wuxing Vice Director."

units.zh: 文季答曰：「琅邪執法，似不出卿門。」
units.literal: Wenji replied, "Langye's law enforcement—seems not to come from your gate."
units.idiomatic: Wenji replied, "Langye's law enforcement—seems not to come from your own gate."

units.zh: 乾祐二年春正月乙巳朔，制曰：
units.literal: In spring, the first month of the second year of Qianyou, on the first day of the month, yisi, an edict proclaimed:
units.idiomatic: In spring of the second year of Qianyou, on the first day, yisi, of the first month, an imperial edict proclaimed:

units.zh: 朕以渺躬，獲纘洪緒，念守器承祧之重，懷臨深履薄之憂。
units.literal: I, with my slight person, have obtained succession to the great line, mindful of the heavy charge of guarding the vessel of state and maintaining the ancestral sacrifices, and harboring the anxiety of one standing on the brink over deep water and treading on thin ice.
units.idiomatic: With my slight person I have succeeded to the great succession, mindful of the heavy charge of guarding the vessel of state and maintaining the ancestral line, and filled with the anxiety of one standing on the brink over deep water and treading on thin ice.

units.zh: 屬以天道猶艱，王室多故，天降重戾，國有大喪，奸臣樂禍以圖危，群寇幸災而伺隙，力役未息，兵革方殷。
units.literal: Just then Heaven's way was still arduous, the royal house had many troubles, Heaven sent down heavy calamity, the state had a great bereavement, treacherous ministers rejoiced in disaster to plot peril, bandits in multitudes welcomed calamity to watch for openings, corvée labor had not ceased, and arms were at their height.
units.idiomatic: Just then Heaven's way remained arduous and the royal house met with many troubles; Heaven sent down great calamity and the state suffered a great bereavement. Treacherous ministers rejoiced in disaster to plot peril, while bandits in multitudes welcomed calamity to watch for openings. Corvée labor had not ceased, and war was at its height.

units.zh: 兗州奏，捕蝗四萬斛。
units.literal: Yan Prefecture reported capturing forty thousand hu of locusts.
units.idiomatic: Yan Prefecture reported capturing forty thousand hu of locusts.

units.zh: 壬午，西京留臺侍御史趙礪彈奏，太子太保王延、太子洗馬張季凝等，自去年五月後來，每稱請假，俱是不任拜起。
units.literal: On renwu, the Western Capital deputy censor Zhao Li impeached: the Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent Wang Yan, the Heir Apparent's Stud Zhang Jining, and others, since the fifth month of last year, whenever they claimed leave were all unable to perform bowing and rising.
units.idiomatic: On renwu, the Western Capital deputy censor Zhao Li impeached the Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent Wang Yan, the Heir Apparent's Stud Zhang Jining, and others: since the fifth month of last year, whenever they claimed leave they were all unable to perform bowing and rising.

units.zh: 詔延等宜以本官致仕。
units.literal: An edict ordered Yan and the others to retire with their present offices.
units.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yan and the others to retire with their present offices.

units.zh: 甲申，以陜州節度使、充河中一行兵馬都部署白文珂為西京留守，加兼侍中；
units.literal: On jiashen, the Shan Prefecture military governor and concurrent commander of the Hezhong campaign army and horse Bai Wenke was made Western Capital military commissioner, with the additional title of Palace Attendant;
units.idiomatic: On jiashen, the Shan Prefecture military governor and concurrent commander of the Hezhong campaign army and horse Bai Wenke was appointed Western Capital military commissioner with the additional title of Palace Attendant;

units.zh: 列傳第三十三齊高帝諸子下
units.literal: Biographies 33: Sons of Emperor Gao of Qi, Part Two
units.idiomatic: Biographies 33: Sons of Emperor Gao of Southern Qi, Part Two

units.zh: 臨川獻王映字宣光，高帝第三子也。
units.literal: Prince Xian of Linchuan, Ying, style name Xuanguang, was the third son of Emperor Gao.
units.idiomatic: Ying, Prince Xian of Linchuan, whose style name was Xuanguang, was Emperor Gao's third son.

units.zh: 少而警悟，美言笑，善容止。
units.literal: From youth he was quick-witted; his speech and smile were pleasing, and his bearing was graceful.
units.idiomatic: Even as a boy he was remarkably perceptive, with a pleasing voice and smile and elegant deportment.

units.zh: 隆昌元年，為侍中，領驍騎將軍，尋加秘書監。
units.literal: In the first year of Longchang he became Palace Attendant and commanded the Valiant Cavalry; soon he was also made Director of the Secretariat Archives.
units.idiomatic: In the first year of Longchang he became Palace Attendant and commanded the Valiant Cavalry; soon he was also Director of the Secretariat Archives.

units.zh: 及明帝知權，蕃邸危懼，江祏嘗謂王晏曰：「江夏王有才行，亦善能匿跡，以琴道授羊景之，景之著名，而江夏掩能於世，非唯七弦而已，百氏亦復如之。」
units.literal: When Emperor Ming grasped power the princely residences were in peril; Jiang Shi once said to Wang Yan, "The Prince of Jiangxia has ability and conduct and is also skilled at concealing his talents; he taught the zither to Yang Jingzhi—Jingzhi is famous while Jiangxia hides his ability from the world. It is not only in the seven strings; the hundred schools are likewise."
units.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming seized power the princely residences were in peril; Jiang Shi once told Wang Yan, "The Prince of Jiangxia has talent and conduct and excels at concealing his abilities; he taught the zither to Yang Jingzhi—Jingzhi is famous while Jiangxia hides his skill from the world. It is not only the seven strings; the hundred schools are the same."

units.zh: 鋒聞歎曰：「江祏遂復為混沌畫眉，欲益反弊耳。
units.literal: When Feng heard of it he sighed and said, "Jiang Shi is again painting eyebrows on chaos—he means to help but will only make things worse.
units.idiomatic: When Feng heard of it he sighed and said, "Jiang Shi is again painting eyebrows on chaos—intending to help, he will only make things worse.

units.zh: 鉉年稍長。
units.literal: Xuan gradually grew older.
units.idiomatic: Xuan gradually grew older.

units.zh: 四年，誅王晏，以謀立鉉為名，鉉免官，以王還第，禁不得與外人交通。
units.literal: In the fourth year Wang Yan was executed on the charge of plotting to establish Xuan; Xuan was removed from office, returned to his residence as a prince, and forbidden to have contact with outsiders.
units.idiomatic: In the fourth year Wang Yan was executed on the charge of plotting to establish Xuan; Xuan was removed from office, returned to his residence as a prince, and forbidden contact with outsiders.

units.zh: 永泰元年，明帝疾暴甚，乃見害。
units.literal: In the first year of Yongtai Emperor Ming's illness suddenly worsened greatly, and Xuan was then killed.
units.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongtai Emperor Ming's illness suddenly worsened sharply, and Xuan was then killed.

units.zh: 王秀之字伯奮，琅邪臨沂人也。
units.literal: Wang Xiuzhi, style name Bo Fen, was a native of Langya, Linyi.
units.idiomatic: Wang Xiuzhi, whose style name was Bo Fen, came from Langya commandery in Linyi.

units.zh: 慈議不行。
units.literal: Ci's proposal was not adopted.
units.idiomatic: Ci's proposal was not adopted.

units.zh: 慈患脚，世祖敕王晏曰：「慈在職未久，旣有微疾，不堪朝，又不能騎馬，聽乘車在仗後。」
units.literal: Ci suffered from foot ailment; Emperor Shizu instructed Wang Yan: "Ci has not long been in office and already has a slight illness—he cannot manage court, and also cannot ride horseback; allow him to ride in a carriage behind the guard."
units.idiomatic: Ci suffered from foot ailment. Emperor Wu instructed Wang Yan: "Ci has not long held office and already has a slight illness—he cannot attend court and cannot ride horseback; permit him to ride in a carriage behind the guard."

units.zh: 江左來少例也。
units.literal: Since the Eastern Jin such cases have been few.
units.idiomatic: Such indulgence had been rare since the Eastern Jin.

units.zh: 俄徵黃門郎，未拜，遷吏部郎。
units.literal: Soon summoned as Gentleman at the Yellow Gates; before taking appointment, transferred to Clerk of the Ministry of Personnel.
units.idiomatic: He was soon summoned as Gentleman at the Yellow Gates, but before taking up the appointment he was transferred to Clerk of the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 尚書令王晏選門生補內外要局，慧曉爲用數人而止，晏恨之。
units.literal: Wang Yan, Minister Director of State Affairs, selected his disciples to fill key posts inside and outside; Huixiao used only a few and stopped—Yan resented this.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan, Minister Director of State Affairs, wanted his disciples appointed to key posts throughout the government; Huixiao appointed only a few and stopped, and Yan resented him for it.

units.zh: 送女妓一人，欲與申好，慧曉不納。
units.literal: Yan sent one female entertainer, wishing to establish goodwill; Huixiao did not accept.
units.idiomatic: Yan sent him a female entertainer hoping to win his favor, but Huixiao refused the gift.

units.zh: 吏曹都令史歷政以來，諮執選事，慧曉任己獨行，未嘗與語。
units.literal: The Chief Clerk of the Ministry of Personnel under successive administrations had handled selection matters through consultation—but Huixiao acted by his own judgment independently and never once spoke with him.
units.idiomatic: Under previous administrations the Chief Clerk of the Ministry of Personnel had controlled appointments through consultation; Huixiao exercised his own judgment independently and never once spoke with him.

title.raw: 卷二十七 列傳第二十一 陸倕 到洽 明山賓 殷鈞 陸襄 Volume 27: Lu Chui; Dao Qia; Ming Shanbin; Yin Jun

units.zh: 梁書卷第二十七 列傳第二十一
units.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 27, Biographies, Number 21
units.idiomatic: Book of Liang, Volume 27, Biographies, Number 21

units.zh: 陸倕 到洽 明山賓 殷鈞 陸襄
units.literal: Lu Chui, Dao Qia, Ming Shanbin, Yin Jun, and Lu Xiang
units.idiomatic: Lu Chui; Dao Qia; Ming Shanbin; Yin Jun; and Lu Xiang

units.zh: 陸倕字佐公，吳郡吳人也。
units.literal: Lu Chui, styled Zuogong, was a man of Wu county in Wu commandery.
units.idiomatic: Lu Chui, styled Zuogong, came from Wu county in Wu commandery.

units.zh: 諡曰質子。
units.literal: His posthumous title was Zhizi.
units.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Zhizi, "The Sincere."

units.zh: 昭明太子爲舉哀，賻錢十萬，布百匹，並使舍人王顒監護喪事。
units.literal: Crown Prince Zhaoming performed mourning rites for him, sent funeral gifts of one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth, and dispatched Attendant Wang Yan to oversee the funeral affairs.
units.idiomatic: Crown Prince Zhaoming performed mourning rites for him, sent funeral gifts of one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth, and dispatched attendant Wang Yan to oversee the funeral affairs.

units.zh: 又與前司徒左長史殷芸令曰：「北兗信至，明常侍遂至殞逝，聞之傷怛。
units.literal: He also sent a letter to the former Left Chief Clerk of the Secretariat, Yin Yun, saying, "Word has come from Northern Yanzhou; Attendant-in-Ordinary Ming has now passed away—hearing it wounds me deeply.
units.idiomatic: He also sent a letter to the former left chief clerk of the Secretariat, Yin Yun, saying, "Word has come from Northern Yanzhou; attendant-in-ordinary Ming has now passed away—hearing it wounds me deeply.

title.zh: 卷十一 志第一 禮樂一
title.en: Volume 11 Treatises 1: Rites and Music 1
title.raw: 卷十一 志第一 禮樂一 Volume 11 Treatises 1: Rites and Music 1

units.zh: 由三代而上，治出於一，而禮樂達于天下；
units.literal: From the Three Dynasties upward, governance issued from one source, and rites and music reached throughout the realm;
units.idiomatic: Before the Three Dynasties ended, government and ritual issued from a single source, and rites and music permeated the realm;

units.zh: 由三代而下，治出於二，而禮樂為虛名。
units.literal: From the Three Dynasties downward, governance issued from two sources, and rites and music became empty names.
units.idiomatic: After the Three Dynasties, government split in two, and rites and music became mere names.

units.zh: 古者，宮室車輿以為居，衣裳冕弁以為服，尊爵俎豆以為器，金石絲竹以為樂，以適郊廟，以臨朝廷，以事神而治民。
units.literal: In antiquity, palaces and carriages served as dwelling; robes, caps, and coronets served as dress; goblets, bells, and stands served as vessels; metal, stone, silk, and bamboo served as music—to attend suburban altars and ancestral temples, to preside at court, to serve the spirits and govern the people.
units.idiomatic: In antiquity, palaces and carriages were one's home, garments and ceremonial caps one's dress, goblets and sacrificial stands one's vessels, and metal, stone, silk, and bamboo one's music—used at suburban altars and temples, at court, to serve the spirits and govern the people.

units.zh: 玄宗開元十年，以國子司業韋縚為禮儀使，以掌五禮。
units.literal: In the tenth year of Xuanzong's Kaiyuan reign, Wei Zong of the Directorate of Education was made Commissioner of Ritual Protocol to oversee the Five Rites.
units.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xuanzong's Kaiyuan reign, Wei Zong of the Directorate of Education was made Commissioner of Ritual Protocol to oversee the Five Rites.

units.zh: 十四年，通事舍人王喦上疏，請刪去禮記舊文而益以今事，詔付集賢院議。
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, Remonstrance Clerk Wang Yan memorialized, asking to delete old text from the Book of Rites and add present affairs; an edict referred it to the Academy of Scholarly Worthies for deliberation.
units.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, Remonstrance Clerk Wang Yan memorialized, asking to delete old text from the Book of Rites and add present affairs; an edict referred it to the Academy of Scholarly Worthies for deliberation.

units.zh: 學士張說以為禮記不刊之書，去聖久遠，不可改易，而唐貞觀顯慶禮，儀注前後不同，宜加折衷，以為唐禮。
units.literal: Academician Zhang Yue held that the Book of Rites was an unalterable book, far from the sages and not to be changed, while Tang's Zhenguan and Xianqing rituals had ritual directions that differed before and after and should be harmonized into Tang ritual.
units.idiomatic: Academician Zhang Yue held that the Book of Rites was an unalterable book, far from the sages and not to be changed, while Tang's Zhenguan and Xianqing rituals had ritual directions that differed before and after and should be harmonized into Tang ritual.

title.zh: 卷二十 周世宗家人傳第八:
title.en: Volume 20: Shizong of Later Zhou's Family
title.raw: 卷二十 周世宗家人傳第八: Volume 20: Shizong of Later Zhou's Family

units.zh: 柴守禮
units.literal: Chai Shouli
units.idiomatic: Chai Shouli

units.zh: 周太祖聖穆皇后柴氏，無子，養後兄守禮之子以為子，是為世宗。
units.literal: Empress Shengmu, née Chai, of Zhou Taizu had no son; she adopted the son of her elder brother Shouli as her own, and this was Shizong.
units.idiomatic: Empress Shengmu of the Chai clan, wife of Later Zhou's Taizu, bore no sons. She adopted her elder brother Shouli's son as her own; that child became Shizong.

units.zh: 守禮字克讓，以後族拜銀青光祿大夫、檢校吏部尚書、兼御史大夫。
units.literal: Shouli, style name Kerang, by virtue of the empress's kin was appointed Silver-Gleaming Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Acting Minister of Personnel, and concurrent Censor-in-Chief.
units.idiomatic: Shouli, courtesy name Kerang, was made Silver-Gleaming Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, acting Minister of Personnel, and concurrent Censor-in-Chief on account of his ties to the empress's clan.

units.zh: 致仕，居於洛陽，終世宗之世，未嘗至京師，而左右亦莫敢言，第以元舅禮之，而守禮亦頗恣橫，嘗殺人於市，有司有聞，世宗不問。
units.literal: He retired and lived in Luoyang. Throughout Shizong's reign he never came to the capital, yet those around the throne dared not speak of it; they merely treated him with the rites due an imperial maternal uncle. Shouli was also rather overbearing and once killed a man in the marketplace. When the authorities reported it, Shizong made no inquiry.
units.idiomatic: He retired to Luoyang and never once came to the capital during Shizong's entire reign, yet no one at court dared raise the matter; they could only honor him as the emperor's maternal uncle. Shouli was also quite overbearing and once killed a man in the marketplace. When officials reported it, Shizong took no action.

units.zh: 是時，王溥、汪晏、王彥超、韓令坤等同時將相，皆有父在洛陽，與守禮朝夕往來，惟意所為，洛陽人多畏避之，號「十阿父。」
units.literal: At that time Wang Pu, Wang Yan, Wang Yanchao, Han Lingkun, and others were simultaneously generals and chief ministers; each had a father in Luoyang who associated with Shouli morning and evening, doing as they pleased. Many in Luoyang feared and avoided them, calling them the "Ten Foster Fathers."
units.idiomatic: At the time Wang Pu, Wang Yan, Wang Yanchao, Han Lingkun, and others were serving together as generals and chief ministers. Each had a father living in Luoyang who kept company with Shouli day and night and did as they pleased. The people of Luoyang mostly feared and avoided them, calling them the "Ten Foster Fathers."

units.zh: 守禮卒年七十二，官至太傅。
units.literal: Shouli died at seventy-two, having reached the office of Grand Tutor.
units.idiomatic: Shouli died at seventy-two, having risen to Grand Tutor.

title.raw: 卷三百九十一 列傳第一百五十 周必大 留正 胡晉臣 Volume 391 Biographies 150: Zhou Bida, Liu Zheng, Hu Jinchen

units.zh: 周必大
units.literal: Zhou Bida
units.idiomatic: Zhou Bida

units.zh: 周必大，字子充，一字洪道，其先鄭州管城人。
units.literal: Zhou Bida, courtesy name Zichong, with an alternate name Hongdao; his ancestors were from Guancheng in Zheng Prefecture.
units.idiomatic: Zhou Bida, whose courtesy name was Zichong and who also used the name Hongdao, came from a family originally of Guancheng in Zheng Prefecture.

units.zh: 祖詵，宣和中倅廬陵，因家焉。
units.literal: His grandfather Shen, during the Xuanhe reign served as vice-prefect of Luling, and thereby made his home there.
units.idiomatic: His grandfather Shen served as vice-prefect of Luling during the Xuanhe period and settled the family there.

units.zh: 貴戚預政，公私兩失，臣不敢具草。」
units.literal: Imperial kin interfering in government — public and private both lose; your servant dares not draft the document."
units.idiomatic: When imperial kin interfere in government, both public and private interest suffer. I dare not draft the document."

units.zh: 上批：「王嚴疾速撰入。
units.literal: The emperor annotated: "Wang Yan — draft it immediately.
units.idiomatic: The emperor annotated, "Wang Yan — draft it at once.

units.zh: 濟、必大予宮觀，日下出國門。」
units.literal: Mo Ji and Bida were given palace-temple posts and ordered to leave the capital gate that very day."
units.idiomatic: Mo Ji and Bida were given palace-temple posts and ordered out of the capital gate that same day."

title.en: Volume 97 Jin Records 19
title.raw: 卷97 晉紀十九

units.zh: 資治通鑑 第097卷
units.literal: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 97.
units.idiomatic: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 97.

units.zh: 【晉紀十九】 起玄黓攝提格，盡強圉協洽，凡六年。
units.literal: [Jin Annals 19] Beginning Xuanji Shetige, ending Qiangyu Xiejia, six years in all.
units.idiomatic: [Jin Annals 19] From Xuanji Shetige through Qiangyu Xiejia—six years in all.

units.zh: 春，正月，己未朔，日有食之。
units.literal: In spring, the first month, on the new-moon day jìwèi, there was a solar eclipse.
units.idiomatic: In spring, on the first day of the first month (jìwèi), the day of the new moon, a solar eclipse occurred.

units.zh: 詔除侍中、安西軍司，浩不應。
units.literal: an edict appointed him Palace Attendant and Army Aide of the Anxi command, but Hao did not accept.
units.idiomatic: the court appointed him Palace Attendant and army aide of the Anxi command, but Hao declined.

units.zh: 翼遺浩書曰：「王夷甫立名非真，雖雲談道，實長華競。
units.literal: Yi sent Hao a letter saying, "Wang Yifu made a name that was not genuine; though he spoke of the Way, in truth he fostered empty rivalry.
units.idiomatic: Yi wrote to Hao: "Wang Yifu won a reputation that was not genuine; though he spoke of the Way, he in truth fostered empty rivalry.

units.zh: 明德君子，遇會處際，寧可然乎！」
units.literal: Can a bright and virtuous gentleman, meeting his moment and place, act thus!"
units.idiomatic: Can a bright and virtuous gentleman, meeting his moment, act thus!"

title.zh: 卷八十四 晉書10: 少帝本紀四
title.en: Volume 84 Book of Later Jin 10: Emperor Shao 3
title.raw: 卷八十四 晉書10: 少帝本紀四 Volume 84 Book of Later Jin 10: Emperor Shao 3

units.zh: 開運二年夏五月丙申朔，帝御崇元殿受朝，大赦天下。
units.literal: In the second year of Kaiyun, on the first day bingshen of the fifth summer month, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall to receive court homage and proclaimed a general amnesty for all under Heaven.
units.idiomatic: In Kaiyun 2, on the first day bingshen of the fifth summer month, the emperor held court at Chongyuan Hall, received homage, and proclaimed a general amnesty.

units.zh: 丁酉，以右衛上將軍馬萬為左金吾上將軍致仕。
units.literal: On dingyou, Ma Wan, General of the Right Guard, was made retired General of the Left Golden Chancellery.
units.idiomatic: On dingyou Ma Wan, General of the Right Guard, was retired as General of the Left Golden Chancellery.

units.zh: 戊戌，陜州節度使宋彥筠移鎮鄧州，澶州節度使何建移鎮河陽。
units.literal: On wuxu, Song Yanyun, military commissioner of Shaan Prefecture, was transferred to Deng Prefecture, and He Jian, military commissioner of Chan Prefecture, was transferred to Heyang.
units.idiomatic: On wuxu Song Yanyun moved from Shaan to Deng Prefecture, and He Jian from Chan to Heyang.

units.zh: 冬十月戊寅，以河陽節度使何建為涇州節度使，以許州節度使李從溫為河陽節度使，以前鄭州節度使石赟為曹州節度使。
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wuyin, He Jian, military commissioner of Heyang, was made military commissioner of Jing Prefecture; Li Congwen, military commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Heyang; Shi Yun, former military commissioner of Zheng Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Cao Prefecture.
units.idiomatic: On wuyin of the tenth winter month He Jian moved from Heyang to Jing, Li Congwen from Xu to Heyang, and former Zheng commissioner Shi Yun to Cao.

units.zh: 庚午，遣使太子賓客羅周嶽、使副太子右庶子王延濟冊兩浙節度使錢宏佐為守太尉。
units.literal: On gengwu, envoys were dispatched: chief envoy Luo Zhouyue, Mentor of the Heir Apparent, and deputy envoy Wang Yanji, Right Vice Mentor of the Heir Apparent, to invest Qian Hongzuo, military commissioner of the Two Zhes, as Defender of Grand Marshal.
units.idiomatic: On gengwu chief envoy Luo Zhouyue and deputy Wang Yanji were sent to invest Two-Zhe commissioner Qian Hongzuo as Defender of Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 辛未，右金吾衛上將軍楊彥詢卒，贈太子太師。
units.literal: On xinwei, Yang Yanxun, General of the Right Golden Chancellery Guard, died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
units.idiomatic: On xinwei Yang Yanxun, General of the Right Golden Chancellery Guard, died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 詔李守貞為北面行營都部署，滑州皇甫遇為副，相州張彥澤充馬軍都指揮使，定州李殷充步軍都指揮使。
units.literal: An edict made Li Shouzhen overall commander of the Northern Circuit field headquarters, Huangfu Yu of Hua Prefecture deputy, Zhang Yanze of Xiang Prefecture commander of the cavalry, and Li Yin of Ding Prefecture commander of the infantry.
units.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen was made northern commander, Huangfu Yu of Hua deputy, Zhang Yanze of Xiang cavalry commander, and Li Yin of Ding infantry commander.

units.zh: 七月壬辰，以禮部尚書王延為刑部尚書，以工部尚書王松為禮部尚書，以太常卿龍敏為工部尚書，以左丞李慎儀為太常卿，以吏部侍郎張昭遠為左丞，以右丞李詳為吏部侍郎，以前義州刺史李玘為右丞。
units.literal: In the seventh month, on renchen, Wang Yan, Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Justice; Wang Song, Minister of Works, was made Minister of Rites; Long Min, Director of Ceremonies, was made Minister of Works; Li Shenyi, Left Vice Director, was made Director of Ceremonies; Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of the Civil Office, was made Left Vice Director; Li Xiang, Right Vice Director, was made Vice Minister of the Civil Office; Li Qi, former prefect of Yi Prefecture, was made Right Vice Director.
units.idiomatic: On renchen of the seventh month Wang Yan moved to Justice, Wang Song to Rites, Long Min to Works, Li Shenyi to Ceremonies, Zhang Zhaoyuan to Left Vice Director, Li Xiang to Civil Vice Minister, and former Yi prefect Li Qi to Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 前晉昌軍節度使安彥威薨，輟朝，贈太師。
units.literal: An Yanwei, former military commissioner of the Jinchang Army, died; court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
units.idiomatic: Former Jinchang commissioner An Yanwei died; audiences were suspended and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 乙巳，詔安審琦率兵赴鄴都，皇甫遇赴相州。
units.literal: On yisi, an edict ordered An Shenqi to lead troops to Ye and Huangfu Yu to Xiang Prefecture.
units.idiomatic: On yisi An Shenqi was ordered to Ye and Huangfu Yu to Xiang.

units.zh: 丙午，以太子少保楊凝式為太子少傅，以刑部尚書王延為太子少保，前潁州團練使竇貞固為刑部尚書。
units.literal: On bingwu, Yang Ningshi, Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Senior Mentor; Wang Yan, Minister of Justice, was made Junior Mentor; Dou Zhengu, former training commissioner of Ying Prefecture, was made Minister of Justice.
units.idiomatic: On bingwu Yang Ningshi became Senior Mentor, Wang Yan Junior Mentor, and former Ying commissioner Dou Zhengu Minister of Justice.

units.zh: 是月，河南、河北、關西諸州奏，大水霖雨不止，溝河泛濫，水入城郭及損害秋稼。
units.literal: That month Henan, Hebei, and the western passes reported that great floods and unending rains made ditches and rivers overflow, water entered cities, and the autumn grain was harmed.
units.idiomatic: That month Henan, Hebei, and the western passes reported floods, endless rain, cities inundated, and crops ruined.

title.zh: 卷七十三 四夷附錄第二: 契丹
title.en: Volume 73: Appendix on the Four Barbarians 2: Khitan 2
title.raw: 卷七十三 四夷附錄第二: 契丹 Volume 73: Appendix on the Four Barbarians 2: Khitan 2

units.zh: 兀欲，東丹王突欲子也。
units.literal: Wuyu was the son of the Dongdan King Tuyu.
units.idiomatic: Wuyu was a son of Tuyu, the Dongdan King.

units.zh: 突欲奔于唐，兀欲留不從，號永康王。
units.literal: Tuyu fled to Tang, but Wuyu stayed behind and would not follow; he was styled Prince of Yongkang.
units.idiomatic: When Tuyu defected to Tang, Wuyu remained in Khitan territory and refused to go with him, taking the title Prince of Yongkang.

units.zh: 契丹好飲人血，突欲左右姬妾，多刺其臂吮之，其小過輒挑目、刲灼，不勝其毒。
units.literal: The Khitan were fond of drinking human blood; Tuyu's concubines and attendants often pricked their arms for him to suck, and for minor faults he would gouge out eyes or brand and burn them, and they could not endure the cruelty.
units.idiomatic: The Khitan custom favored drinking human blood; Tuyu's women and attendants often let him prick their arms and suck the blood, while petty offenses brought gouged eyes, branding, and cautery until they could bear no more.

units.zh: 述律立，遂不復南寇。
units.literal: When Shulü took the throne he no longer raided south.
units.idiomatic: Once Shulü was enthroned he ceased southern raids.

units.zh: 顯德六年夏，世宗北伐，以保大軍節度使田景咸為淤口關部署，右神武統軍李洪信為合流口部署，前鳳翔節度使王晏為益津關部署，侍衛親軍馬步都虞候韓通為陸路都部署。
units.literal: In the summer of the sixth year of Xiande, Shizong marched north; he made Baoda Army Commissioner Tian Jingxian commander at Yankou Pass, Right Divine Martial Commander Li Hongxin commander at the He-Liu mouth, former Fengxiang Commissioner Wang Yan commander at Yijin Pass, and Palace Guard Director Han Tong overall land commander.
units.idiomatic: In summer, the sixth year of Xiande, Shizong marched north, appointing Tian Jingxian of Baoda to Yankou Pass, Li Hongxin of the Right Divine Martial Guard to the He-Liu mouth, Wang Yan, former Fengxiang commissioner, to Yijin Pass, and Han Tong, director of the palace guard, overall land commander.

units.zh: 世宗自乾寧軍御龍舟，艛船戰艦，首尾數十里，至益津關，降其守將，而河路漸狹，舟不能進，乃捨舟陸行。
units.literal: Shizong himself sailed from Qianning on the imperial dragon boat with warships stretching for dozens of li; reaching Yijin Pass he accepted the surrender of its garrison, but the river route grew narrow and boats could not advance, so he left the fleet and marched by land.
units.idiomatic: Shizong sailed from Qianning on the imperial dragon boat with a fleet dozens of li long; at Yijin Pass the garrison surrendered, but the channel narrowed and the boats could go no farther, so he abandoned the river and marched overland.

title.zh: 卷293 列傳八十 李绂 蔡珽 谢济世 陈学海
title.en: Volume 293 Biographies 80: Li Fu, Cai Ting, Xie Jishi, Chen Xuehai
title.raw: 卷293 列傳八十 李绂 蔡珽 谢济世 陈学海

units.zh: 列傳八十
units.literal: Biographies 80
units.idiomatic: Biographies 80

units.zh: 李紱蔡珽謝濟世陳學海
units.literal: Li Fu, Cai Ting, Xie Jishi, Chen Xuehai
units.idiomatic: Li Fu, Cai Ting, Xie Jishi, and Chen Xuehai

units.zh: 李紱，字巨來，江西臨川人。
units.literal: Li Fu, styled Julai, was a man of Linchuan in Jiangxi.
units.idiomatic: Li Fu, whose style name was Julai, came from Linchuan in Jiangxi.

units.zh: 紱過河南，詰文鏡胡為有意蹂踐士人。
units.literal: When Fu passed through Henan he questioned Wenjing: why deliberately trample upon scholars?
units.idiomatic: When Fu passed through Henan he confronted Wenjing, asking why he deliberately abused men of learning.

units.zh: 入對，因極言文鏡貪虐，且謂文鏡所劾屬吏，如振國及邵言綸、汪諴皆枉，振國已死獄中。
units.literal: At audience he spoke at length of Wenjing's greed and cruelty, and said that subordinates Wenjing had impeached, such as Zhenguo, Shao Yanlun, and Wang Yan, were all wronged, and Zhenguo had already died in prison.
units.idiomatic: At audience he spoke at length of Wenjing's greed and cruelty, and said that subordinates Wenjing had impeached—among them Zhenguo, Shao Yanlun, and Wang Yan—had all been wronged, and that Zhenguo had already died in prison.

units.zh: 文鏡因紱語，先密疏聞，謂紱與振國同年袒護。
units.literal: Because of Fu's words, Wenjing first sent a secret memorial, saying Fu and Zhenguo were examination cohort-mates and Fu was showing favoritism.
units.idiomatic: Because of Fu's remarks, Wenjing sent a secret memorial first, claiming that Fu and Zhenguo were examination cohort-mates and that Fu was shielding him.

units.zh: 讞上，以濟世所言風聞無據，顯係聽人指使，要結朋黨，擬斬。
units.literal: When the sentence was submitted, because Jishi's words were hearsay without basis, clearly listening to others' direction and forming factions, execution was proposed.
units.idiomatic: When the sentence was submitted, because Jishi's charges were hearsay without basis and he had clearly acted at others' direction and formed factions, execution was proposed.

units.zh: 文鏡劾屬吏黃振國、邵言綸、汪諴等，李紱訟言其枉，並謂河南諸吏張球最劣，文鏡縱弗糾。
units.literal: Wenjing impeached subordinates Huang Zhenguo, Shao Yanlun, Wang Yan, and others. Li Fu argued they were wronged and also said among Henan officials Zhang Qiu was the worst, yet Wenjing indulged him and did not impeach.
units.idiomatic: Wenjing had impeached subordinates Huang Zhenguo, Shao Yanlun, Wang Yan, and others. Li Fu argued they had been wronged and also said that among Henan officials Zhang Qiu was the worst, yet Wenjing indulged him and did not impeach him.

units.zh: 入對，具為上言之。
units.literal: At audience he fully stated this to the emperor.
units.idiomatic: At audience he fully stated this to the emperor.

units.zh: 上先入文鏡言，不直紱，而濟世罪狀文鏡又及枉振國、言綸、諴庇球諸事。
units.literal: The emperor had first accepted Wenjing's words and did not side with Fu, yet Jishi's charges against Wenjing again cited the wrongful cases of Zhenguo, Yanlun, and Yan and shielding Qiu.
units.idiomatic: The emperor had first accepted Wenjing's account and did not side with Fu, yet Jishi's charges against Wenjing again cited the wrongful cases of Zhenguo, Yanlun, and Yan and Wenjing's shielding of Qiu.

units.zh: 上召大學士、九卿、科道等入見，舉前事，謂：「濟世言與紱奏一一吻合，今詰濟世劾文鏡諸事，濟世皆茫無憑據，俯首無詞，是其受人指使，情弊顯見。」
units.literal: The emperor summoned grand secretaries, Nine Chief Ministers, censors, and others for audience, cited the prior matters, and said: 'Jishi's words match Fu's memorials one by one. Now when Jishi is questioned on his impeachment of Wenjing, he has no basis for any of it and bows his head without words—clearly he was directed by others; the circumstances are obvious.'
units.idiomatic: The emperor summoned the grand secretaries, Nine Chief Ministers, censors, and others for audience, cited the prior matters, and said, "Jishi's words match Fu's memorials point for point. Now when Jishi is questioned on his impeachment of Wenjing, he has no basis for any of it and bows his head without a word—clearly he was directed by others; the circumstances are obvious."

title.en: Volume 198 Biographies 123: Confucian Scholars 1
title.raw: 卷一百九十八 列傳第一百二十三 儒學上 Volume 198 Biographies 123: Confucian Scholars 1

units.zh: 儒學上
units.literal: Confucian Scholars, Part One
units.idiomatic: Confucian Scholars, Part One

units.zh: 徐文遠陸德明曹憲顏師古
units.literal: Xu Wenyuan, Lu Deming, Cao Xian, Yan Shigu
units.idiomatic: Xu Wenyuan, Lu Deming, Cao Xian, and Yan Shigu

units.zh: （時相遊秦）
units.literal: (Shi Xiang, You Qin)
units.idiomatic: (Shi Xiang and You Qin)

units.zh: 後致仕，卒，陪葬昭陵，贈太常卿，謚曰憲。
units.literal: Later he retired from office, died, was buried with honor at Zhaoling, was posthumously appointed Minister of Ceremonies, and given the posthumous title Xian.
units.idiomatic: He later retired, died, and was buried with honor at Zhaoling; posthumously he was made Minister of Ceremonies and given the posthumous title Xian.

units.zh: 初，穎達與顏師古、司馬才章、王恭、王琰受詔撰《五經》義訓凡百餘篇，號《義贊》，詔改為《正義》雲。
units.literal: At first Yingda together with Yan Shigu, Sima Caizhang, Wang Gong, and Wang Yan received orders to compile exegesis on the Five Classics totaling more than one hundred chapters, titled Yizan; an edict changed it to Zhengyi.
units.idiomatic: Earlier, Yingda had joined Yan Shigu, Sima Caizhang, Wang Gong, and Wang Yan in compiling more than one hundred chapters of exegesis on the Five Classics under the title Yizan; an edict renamed the work Zhengyi.

units.zh: 雖包貫異家為詳博，然其中不能無謬冗，博士馬嘉運駁正其失，至相譏詆。
units.literal: Though it encompassed divergent schools and was detailed and broad, within it there could not but be errors and redundancy; Erudite Ma Jiayun refuted and corrected its faults, to the point of mutual ridicule and slander.
units.idiomatic: Although the work embraced many schools and was exhaustive, it could not avoid error and redundancy; Erudite Ma Jiayun attacked its mistakes, and the two sides exchanged ridicule and slander.

title.zh: 卷一百十二 周書3: 太祖本紀三
title.en: Volume 112 Book of Later Zhou 14: Taizu Annals 3
title.raw: 卷一百十二 周書3: 太祖本紀三 Volume 112 Book of Later Zhou 14: Taizu Annals 3

units.zh: 廣順元年冬十月己丑朔，宰臣王峻獻唐張蘊古《大寶箴》、謝偃《惟皇誡德賦》二圖。
units.literal: On the jichou new moon of the tenth month in winter, Guangshun year 1, Chief Minister Wang Jun presented two illustrated works from Tang: Zhang Yungu's Great Treasure Admonition and Xie Yan's Admonition on the Emperor's Virtue.
units.idiomatic: On the jichou new moon in the tenth month of winter, Guangshun 1, Chief Minister Wang Jun presented two Tang-era illustrated texts: Zhang Yungu's Great Treasure Admonition and Xie Yan's Admonition on the Emperor's Virtue.

units.zh: 詔報曰：「朕生長軍戎，勤勞南北，雖用心於《鈐》、《匱》，且無暇於《詩》、《書》，世務時艱，粗經閱歷，前言往行，未甚討尋。
units.literal: An edict in reply said: "I grew up amid armies and toiled north and south; though I applied myself to the military manuals Qian and Kui, I had no leisure for the Odes and Documents; the affairs of the age and their hardships I have only roughly experienced, and the words and deeds of former ages I have not much investigated.
units.idiomatic: The Emperor replied by edict: "I was raised in the military and labored north and south; though I studied the war manuals Qian and Kui, I never had time for the Odes and Documents; I have only a rough acquaintance with the troubles of the times and have scarcely explored the wisdom of the past.

units.zh: 卿有佐命立國之勛，居代天調鼎之任，恒慮眇德，未及古人。
units.literal: You have merit in aiding the Mandate and founding the state, and hold the charge of regulating the realm on Heaven's behalf; I always fear my slight virtue falls short of the ancients.
units.idiomatic: You aided the founding of the dynasty and now regulate the realm in Heaven's stead; I constantly worry that my limited virtue cannot match the ancients.

units.zh: 丁酉，皇子澶州節度使榮落起復，加同平章事。
units.literal: On dingyou, Prince Rong, military governor of Cao Prefecture, left mourning restoration and was made co-equal Grand Councilor.
units.idiomatic: On dingyou, Prince Rong, military governor of Cao Prefecture, left mourning restoration and was appointed co-equal Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 戊戌，太子少傅致仕王延卒。
units.literal: On wuxu, retired Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Wang Yan died.
units.idiomatic: On wuxu, Wang Yan, retired Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, died.

units.zh: 壬寅，幸西莊。
units.literal: On renyin, the Emperor visited the Western Villa.
units.idiomatic: On renyin, the Emperor visited the Western Villa.

title.zh: 卷三十二 本紀第三十二 高宗九
title.en: Volume 32 Annals 32: Gaozong 9
title.raw: 卷三十二 本紀第三十二 高宗九 Volume 32 Annals 32: Gaozong 9

units.zh: 三十一年春正月甲戌朔，以日食，不受朝。
units.literal: Thirty-first year, spring, first month, day jiaxu new moon: because of a solar eclipse, court audience was not held.
units.idiomatic: Year 31, spring, jiaxu new moon: Gaozong canceled audience for the eclipse.

units.zh: 丁丑，雷。
units.literal: Day dingchou: thunder.
units.idiomatic: On dingchou, thunder rolled.

units.zh: 丁亥，免湖州增丁所輸絹。
units.literal: Day dinghai: the silk paid by Huzhou for added registered households was remitted.
units.idiomatic: On dinghai, Huzhou was freed from added-household silk levies.

units.zh: 乙未，行新造會子於淮、浙、湖北、京西諸州。
units.literal: Day yiwei: newly minted exchange notes were put into circulation in the Huai, Zhe, Hubei, and Jingxi prefectures.
units.idiomatic: On yiwei, new exchange notes circulated in the Huai, Zhe, Hubei, and Jingxi.

units.zh: 是月，金主亮徙都汴京，命其臣劉萼由唐、鄧瞰荊、襄，張中彥、王彥章據秦、鳳、窺巴、蜀，蘇保衡、完顏鄭家奴由海道趨兩浙。
units.literal: That month, the Jin ruler Hailing moved the capital to Bianjing; he ordered his minister Liu E from Tang and Deng to overlook Jing and Xiang; Zhang Zhongyan and Wang Yanchang to hold Qin and Feng and spy on Ba and Shu; Su Baoheng and Wanyan Zhengjianu by sea toward the two Zhes.
units.idiomatic: That month Hailing moved to Bianjing; Liu E threatened Jing and Xiang from Tang and Deng; Zhang Zhongyan and Wang Yanchang menaced Ba and Shu from Qin and Feng; Su Baoheng and Wanyan Zhengjianu sailed toward Zhe.

units.zh: 八月辛丑朔，忠義人魏勝復海州，李寶承制以勝知州事。
units.literal: Eighth month, day xinchou new moon: loyalist Wei Sheng recovered Haizhou; Li Bao, by provisional order, made Sheng prefect.
units.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinchou new moon: Wei Sheng retook Haizhou; Li Bao made him prefect.

units.zh: 丙辰，金主亮入廬州，王權自昭關遁，金人追至尉子橋，破敵軍統制姚興戰死，權退保和州。
units.literal: Day bingchen: the Jin ruler Hailing entered Luzhou; Wang Quan fled from Zhaoguan; the Jin pursued to Weizi Bridge; Break-the-Enemy controller Yao Xing died fighting; Quan fell back to defend Hezhou.
units.idiomatic: On bingchen, Hailing entered Luzhou; Wang Quan fled Zhaoguan; at Weizi Bridge Yao Xing fell; Quan held Hezhou.

units.zh: 金州都統制王彥遣統制任天錫出洵陽，復豐陽縣。
units.literal: Jinzhou overall commander Wang Yan sent controller Ren Tiansi out of Xunyang and recovered Fengyang county.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan's Ren Tiansi left Xunyang and retook Fengyang.

units.zh: 丁巳，帝聞王權敗，召楊存中同宰執議於內殿，陳康伯贊帝定議親征。
units.literal: Day dingsi: the Emperor, hearing Wang Quan was defeated, summoned Yang Cunzhong with the chief ministers to discuss in the inner hall; Chen Kangbo praised the Emperor for fixing on campaigning in person.
units.idiomatic: On dingsi, hearing of Wang Quan's defeat, Gaozong called Yang Cunzhong and the councilors within; Chen Kangbo praised his resolve to take the field.

units.zh: 金主亮焚其舟而去。
units.literal: The Jin ruler Hailing burned his boats and left.
units.idiomatic: Hailing burned his boats and withdrew.

units.zh: 戊寅，王彥遣將楊堅復欒川縣。
units.literal: Day wuyin: Wang Yan sent General Yang Jian to recover Luanchuan county.
units.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wang Yan's Yang Jian retook Luanchuan.

units.zh: 己卯，以湯思退為行宮留守。
units.literal: Day jimao: Tang Situi was made mobile-court resident.
units.idiomatic: On jimao, Tang Situi was made mobile-court resident.

units.zh: 復犯襄陽，統制官李勝等拒卻之，復通化軍。
units.literal: They again attacked Xiangyang; controller Li Sheng and others repelled them and restored Tonghua army.
units.idiomatic: They struck Xiangyang again; controller Li Sheng and others drove them off and restored Tonghua army.

units.zh: 王彥遣將楊堅、黨清至西京長水縣及金人戰，敗之。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent generals Yang Jian and Dang Qing to Changshui county west of the Western Capital and fought the Jin, defeating them.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent Yang Jian and Dang Qing to Changshui west of the Western Capital, fought the Jin, and won.

units.zh: 庚寅，復長水縣。
units.literal: Day gengyin: Changshui county was restored.
units.idiomatic: On gengyin, Changshui county was restored.

units.zh: 十二月己亥朔，趙撙夜襲蔡州，復入其城。
units.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai new moon: Zhao Zong by night raided Cai prefecture and re-entered its walls.
units.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jihai new moon: Zhao Zong night-raided Cai prefecture and re-entered the city.

units.zh: 王彥遣兵復福昌縣。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent troops to recover Fuchang county.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent troops to retake Fuchang county.

units.zh: 庚子，楊存中及虞允文渡江至瓜州察金兵。
units.literal: Day gengzi: Yang Cunzhong and Yu Yunwen crossed the river to Guazhou to inspect Jin troops.
units.idiomatic: On gengzi, Yang Cunzhong and Yu Yunwen crossed to Guazhou to scout the Jin.

units.zh: 金統軍劉萼聞茨湖敗，亦退師。
units.literal: Jin overall commander Liu E, hearing of the defeat at Cihu, also withdrew his army.
units.idiomatic: Jin commander Liu E, hearing of Cihu's defeat, also withdrew.

units.zh: 王彥遣將閻玘復澠池縣。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent general Yan Qi to recover Mianchi county.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent Yan Qi to retake Mianchi county.

units.zh: 壬寅，天有白氣。
units.literal: Day renyin: white vapor appeared in the sky.
units.idiomatic: On renyin, white vapor appeared in the sky.

units.zh: 戊午，復引兵來攻，撙又敗之，金兵遁去。
units.literal: Day wuwu: they came again; Zong again defeated them and the Jin fled.
units.idiomatic: On wuwu, they returned; Zong defeated them again and the Jin fled.

units.zh: 王彥遣將馬貴斷河中南橋，金兵來攻，貴戰敗之。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent general Ma Gui to cut the south bridge on the Yellow River; the Jin came to attack and Gui defeated them.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent Ma Gui to cut the Yellow River's south bridge; the Jin attacked and Gui defeated them.

units.zh: 壬戌，詔軍士戰死者祿其家一年，傷重而死于營者半之。
units.literal: Day renxu: an edict granted one year's salary to families of soldiers killed in battle; half for those who died in camp of severe wounds.
units.idiomatic: On renxu, families of soldiers killed in battle received one year's salary; half for those who died in camp of severe wounds.

units.zh: 姚仲遣副將趙銓攻下鎮戎軍，金同知渭州秦弼及其子嵩來歸。
units.literal: Yao Zhong sent deputy Zhao Quan to take Zhenrong army; Jin acting Wei prefecture commissioner Qin Bi and his son Song came over.
units.idiomatic: Yao Zhong's deputy Zhao Quan took Zhenrong army; Jin acting Wei commissioner Qin Bi and his son Song defected.

units.zh: 王彥遣兵救陝州，遇金人於虢州東，敗之，金兵引去。
units.literal: Wang Yan sent troops to relieve Shan prefecture, met the Jin east of Guo prefecture, defeated them, and the Jin withdrew.
units.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent relief to Shan, met the Jin east of Guo, defeated them, and the Jin withdrew.

units.zh: 丁卯，吳珙遣將復永安軍、永寧、福昌、長水三縣。
units.literal: Day dingmao: Wu Gong sent generals to recover Yong'an army and the three counties Yongning, Fuchang, and Changshui.
units.idiomatic: On dingmao, Wu Gong's generals retook Yong'an army and Yongning, Fuchang, and Changshui counties.

units.zh: 甲辰，罷扈從官吏賞典。
units.literal: Day jiachen: reward grants to officials of the imperial retinue were abolished.
units.idiomatic: On jiachen, reward grants to retinue officials were abolished.

units.zh: 乙巳，錄商、虢之功，加吳璘少傅、王彥為保平軍節度使。
units.literal: Day yisi: the merits at Shang and Guo were recorded; Wu Lin was advanced to junior mentor and Wang Yan was made Baoping military commissioner.
units.idiomatic: On yisi, merits at Shang and Guo were recorded; Wu Lin was made junior mentor and Wang Yan Baoping military commissioner.

units.zh: 戊申，吳璘復德順軍，又遣將嚴忠取環州。
units.literal: Day wushen: Wu Lin recovered Deshun army and also sent general Yan Zhong to take Huanzhou.
units.idiomatic: On wushen, Wu Lin recovered Deshun and sent Yan Zhong to take Huanzhou.

title.zh: 卷16 列傳第8 趙貴 獨孤信 侯莫陳崇 十二大將軍
title.en: Volume 16 Biographies 8: Zhao Gui; Du Guxin; Houmo Chencheng; 12 Senior Generals
title.raw: 卷16 列傳第8 趙貴 獨孤信 侯莫陳崇 十二大將軍 Volume 16 Biographies 8: Zhao Gui; Du Guxin; Houmo Chencheng; 12 Senior Generals

units.zh: 趙貴 獨孤信 侯莫陳崇
units.literal: Zhao Gui; Du Guxin; Houmo Chen Chong
units.idiomatic: Zhao Gui — Du Guxin — Houmo Chen Chong

units.zh: 趙貴字元貴，天水南安人也。
units.literal: Zhao Gui, styled Yuangui, was a native of Nan'an in Tianshui.
units.idiomatic: Zhao Gui, styled Yuangui, came from Nan'an in Tianshui commandery.

units.zh: 曾祖達，魏庫部尚書、臨晉子。
units.literal: His great-grandfather Da was Wei Minister of the Treasury and Marquis of Linjin.
units.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Da had served as Wei minister of the treasury and held the title Marquis of Linjin.

units.zh: 自以虧損國威，上書謝罪。
units.literal: Considering himself to have diminished the state's prestige, he submitted a memorial apologizing for his offense.
units.idiomatic: Believing he had shamed the state, he wrote to apologize for his failure.

units.zh: 魏文帝付尚書議之，七兵尚書、陳郡王
units.literal: Emperor Wen of Wei handed the matter to the Masters of Writing for deliberation—the Minister of the Seven Armies, Prince of Chen commandery
units.idiomatic: Emperor Wen of Wei referred the matter to the Masters of Writing—the Minister of the Seven Armies, Prince of Chen commandery

units.zh: （王言）
units.literal: (Wang Yan)
units.idiomatic: [variant: Wang Yan]

units.zh: 玄等議，以為「邊將董戎，龔行天罰，喪師敗績，國刑無舍。
units.literal: Xuan and others deliberated, saying: "Frontier generals who marshal troops and carry Heaven's punishment—when they lose the army and fail in the campaign, the state punishment allows no pardon.
units.idiomatic: Xuan and others deliberated, saying: "Frontier generals who bear Heaven's mandate to chastise wrongdoers and yet lose their armies—the law knows no mercy.
